sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 68 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

review.originNote: Paired station i maps to unchanged source-grid station (i+688)%1376. This keeps both approach intervals interior without changing source trace or timing.

virtualJoins.reason: Lower road occluded beneath the visible deck. Join its own visible approach limits separately from the upper road.

review.note: Native pavement-transition reads with roughly 1-2 m reading precision, not surveyed positional accuracy. Dense fitted controls are not additional independent observations. The source trace runs close to an edge at some bends, so independent left and right offsets retain the pavement, rather than centring a nominal width around that trace. Pit-side road limit follows the separating paint before its merge. No official-length fit or nominal bridge height. Curbs illustrative, banking unknown. Native licensed pixels stay outside the repository. The layout GeoJSON contains all runtime reconstruction data; this shared research record retains replaced original data.

profile.note: Edited from the ICGC 2021-2023 50 cm ground LiDAR terrain model under CC BY 4.0. Bilinear samples at paired road midpoints, compressed within 0.25 m of sampled heights. Both the deck and occluded lower road interpolate only between their separate ground approach endpoints; interior ground cells are excluded from both spans. Heights and clearance remain estimates, not a bridge survey. Original raster crop retained by native source-grid window and SHA256; no nominal deck height assigned.
